newsitem.title: USA: Barnes approves 3-for-1 stock split, buyback.
newsitem.headline: Barnes approves 3-for-1 stock split, buyback.

text.p: Barnes Group Inc said on Friday that its board has approved a three-for-one stock split and a stock repurchase.
If shareholders approve an amendment to increase the number of authorized shares to 60 million from 20 million, the stock dividend would be paid to shareholders on April 25, 1997.
Shareholders of record at the close of business April 3, 1997, would be eligible for the stock dividend.

Barnes said its board also approved the repurchase of up to 500,000 shares on a pre-split basis, or 1.5 million on a post-split basis. The shares would be used for general corporate purposes, Barnes said.
As of February 4, 1997, there were 6,669,471 common shares outstanding, Barnes said.
